violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -The coffee trailer was out of sanitation solution at the time of inspection.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. -Raw wood walls inside the trailer. The end of the counter tops are raw wood and should be resealed.
